description: This file defines Express.js routes for managing service center entities, including GET and POST endpoints with authentication and role-based authorization.

methods.name: GET /api/service-centers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of service centers, accessible to users with 'SuperAdmin' or 'ServiceCenterAdmin' roles.

methods.name: POST /api/service-centers
methods.description: Creates a new service center, restricted to users with 'SuperAdmin' role, expects 'name', optional 'address', and 'admin_id' in the request body.
